overall_assessment: Separating persistent evidence from bounded retrieval text is useful and its storage/length invariants hold in the tested scope. Current source-block selection and reading-window granularity are not yet adequate as a general production chunk method. Token safety is not semantic completeness.

evidence_by_layer.evidence: All original pilot children map back to their hash-bound parent store and reconstruct searchable projections without gaps. The original 762 searchable parents generated 771 children; only 9 parents actually split, yielding 7 heuristic sentence boundaries and 2 newline boundaries. Four added synthetic long-text/code/definition cases generated 63 children with maximum length 256 and exact reconstruction.
evidence_by_layer.limit: This is not exhaustive original-HTML fidelity, semantic sentence segmentation or all-model tokenization proof. Synthetic full-parent reconstruction does not bypass the existing 12000-character delivery budget.

evidence_by_layer.assessment: too many fragmented or metadata-dominated records
evidence_by_layer.evidence: Original pilot median total child length is 84 tokens; median body length is 57 tokens. In 103 children the standalone prefix-token estimate exceeds half the total. There are 67 children with body length at most 16 tokens, including isolated where/and, page-discussion navigation and Type/Level metadata. After the list fix there are still 67 such children.
evidence_by_layer.limit: Small records and large context fractions are inspection flags, not automatic deletion rules. A short definition may be valid; source structure must distinguish metadata/navigation or dependent fragments from self-contained facts.

evidence_by_layer.assessment: single paragraph is sometimes too small
evidence_by_layer.evidence: Plane-strain zero-strain and thickness-stress qualifications are separate parents. The second is in the retrieved candidate pool but not in Top-4. A no-reranking counterfactual that reads contiguous ordinary text with the identical page, anchor and heading path recovers it under the same delivery budget.
evidence_by_layer.limit: This is one concrete reading-window result, not approval to expand every hit to a full section or page. The counterfactual has not been implemented in product delivery and does not fix absent list evidence or unrelated final rankings.

evidence_by_layer.assessment: confirmed classification error fixed for flat lists
evidence_by_layer.evidence: Of the 41 previously deferred list blocks, 40 are structurally flat. Formatting attributes such as class/id were treated too conservatively. The projection now supports these lists, preserves list item order and decimal start/value/reversed numbering, and retains original XML unchanged as evidence. Nested/nondecimal or unmodeled-tail cases still defer explicitly.
evidence_by_layer.limit: Counts refer to these twelve pages and do not measure a percentage of domain knowledge covered. Formula-containing prose is included in the deferred-math count.

evidence_by_layer.layer: retrieval effect of the list fix
evidence_by_layer.evidence: With the same fourteen queries, model, Dense20/BM2520 and Top-4, the coupling rigidity-versus-distributing comparison parent changes from unsearchable to rank 1 with its full original list returned. Three newly searchable lists appear in that Top-4; a restrictions list also appears in the Riks BC follow-up. Other known missing answers were not silently declared solved.
evidence_by_layer.limit: The candidate HNSW graph was rebuilt, and the data is exposed development data. The missing-to-searchable coverage transition is direct evidence, but this is not a general success-rate or single-cause ranking claim.

evidence_by_layer.assessment: do not blame every failure on chunk splitting
evidence_by_layer.evidence: The first warning's complete paragraph was already in the candidate pool and is excluded by final ranking/Top-4. Tie permanence and the Riks BC magnitude paragraph are absent from their candidate pools. The coupling comparison was excluded by projection policy. These need different fixes.

next_priorities_not_implemented_here: Separate source metadata/navigation and dependent equation connectors from standalone searchable knowledge units using DOM structure, not a blacklist of short words.
Evaluate bounded reading units that keep tightly related rules and qualifications together; do not equate a parent with one paragraph or an entire page by default.
Define validated formula/table/nested-list retrieval projections while retaining full source evidence; do not feed raw XML indiscriminately into the encoder.
Continue evaluating final evidence selection independently from source preservation and child token length.
